defects.title: Serverless notice banner occluded the mini-chat composer at 390×844
defects.root_cause: src/serverlessMode.js banner at z-index 2147483000, position:fixed bottom:12px — elementFromPoint on #ondemand-mini-chat-send/-input returned the banner; real taps delivered nothing (harness passed only via element.click()).
defects.fix: banner z-index 180 (below both chat panels 185/186 and key setup 190) + syncWithChatPanels(): hidden while #ondemand-mini-chat / #ondemand-entity-chat is open, restored on close (MutationObserver on the panels + gev:ask-object fast path); unit tests src/serverlessMode.test.mjs (5).

defects.title: Deliverable media rendered as plain anchors (no thumbnails/lightbox/poster/side pane)
defects.root_cause: src/ondemand/miniChat.js renderAnswer() emitted only .od-chat__cite anchors; no media rendering existed.
defects.fix: tokenizeAnswer/classifyMediaUrl/renderDeliverables: documents side by side in a .od-chat__deliverables grid, images as lazy thumbnails that open #ondemand-mini-chat-lightbox, videos as a muted preload=metadata poster (no autoplay, no controls) that opens the #ondemand-mini-chat-media side pane where playback is user-initiated; PDFs preview in a sandboxed iframe; CSS in src/ui/styles/ondemand-chat.css; unit tests src/ondemand/miniChat.media.test.mjs (7).

defects.title: Open mini chat (z 186) covered the PLUGINS dock (z 184) — VERIFY/REFRESH unreachable by pointer
defects.fix: src/ui/styles/plugin-panel.css: body:has(#ondemand-mini-chat[data-open=true]) moves the dock left of the chat (and left of the media pane when open); at ≤640px it stacks above the chat sheet.

defects.title: POST /plugins/verify with an unknown plugin name answered 500 internal_error
defects.root_cause: verify() threw "Unknown plugin contract" uncaught inside handle().
defects.fix: server/ondemand/foundation/plugin-lifecycle.js: names outside the registry → 404 {error:"unknown_plugin", unknown:[…]} before any verify() runs; unit test added (plugin-lifecycle.test.mjs 14/14).
